notes.title: GNS2, 1.0.7 — May 30, 2024

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where control was lost in the Main Menu;

tags.feature: [*] Improved sound in buildings, added echo;
[*] The "Top Secret" achievement can now be activated anywhere by collecting secret notes in any order;

tags.bug: [*] Player no longer gets stuck in bushes;

tags.feature: [*] Added an interesting feature to oil paintings;

tags.balance_change: [*] Some game events have been improved;
[*] Improved overall gameplay performance and stability;

notes.title: GNS2, 1.0.6 — January 23, 2024

tags.feature: Fast travel. You can instantly travel to the locations you have discovered. To do this, you need to use Wooden Signs, which are located at all main locations;
Free Mode. This Mode allows you to activate the effects of Strange Objects at any time, in any location. To access this mode, you need to complete the game;

tags.bug: The achievement "Winter is here." now works;

tags.feature: New events and objects for interaction;
Many locations have been improved, new objects and details have been added;

tags.bug: Improved overall gameplay performance and stability;

tags.bug: [*] Improved overall gameplay performance and stability;

notes.title: GNS2 Demo, Update 2 - Photo Mode
notes.content:
Photo Mode is finally available and now you can take beautiful screenshots using many different settings.

You can enter Photo Mode from the pause menu while in-game.
